news.headline: Intermountain Health Brings Perimeter's Claire™ to the Operating Room, a Landmark in Breast Cancer Surgery Using AI
news.summary: Intermountain Health became the first U.S. health system to commercially deploy Perimeter's Claire OCT system, the only FDA-approved AI-enabled imaging device used during breast cancer surgery, now live at LDS Hospital and American Fork Hospital under the companies' prior systemwide agreement. CEO Adrian Mendes called it a defining moment for Perimeter and for AI in cancer surgery.

news.headline: Brookline Capital Markets Starts Perimeter Medical Imaging AI at Buy; Price Target C$1.54
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets initiated coverage of Perimeter Medical Imaging AI with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 (about US$1.11) price target, versus a July 13 close of C$0.32, adding a new sell-side voice ahead of the Claire commercial ramp.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital Names Perimeter a Healthcare Top Pick, Alongside Profound
news.summary: Paradigm Capital added Perimeter as a new 'Speculative Buy' healthcare Top Pick with a C$0.95 target, citing the Claire commercial rollout, a possible year-end Medicare reimbursement decision, and M&A comparables in breast-surgery medtech (View Point Medical, Endomag, Molli Surgical) trading well above Perimeter's current revenue multiple.

news.headline: Perimeter CEO Lays Out Strategy at Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas
news.summary: CEO Adrian Mendes presented a corporate update on Claire's commercial launch, the sales funnel, and 2026 strategy at the Planet MicroCap Showcase held at the Bellagio in Las Vegas.

news.headline: Perimeter Selected for INOVAIT Pilot Fund to Advance AI for Breast Cancer Surgery
news.summary: Perimeter was chosen for a non-dilutive contribution from Canada's INOVAIT Pilot Fund, partnered with the University of Toronto, to help develop next-generation AI capabilities for Claire, one of only 10 projects selected in the latest funding round.

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI Closes Final Tranche of Non-Brokered Private Placement
news.summary: Perimeter closed the second and final tranche of its non-brokered private placement, adding capital earmarked to support the U.S. commercial launch of the newly FDA-approved Claire device.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Perimeter had not yet reported Q2 2026 results as of mid-August; based on prior-quarter timing (Q1 2026 reported May 28, 2026), a report and conference call covering Claire placement momentum and cash runway is expected in late August or early September.

catalysts.label: Claire commercial hospital placements
catalysts.detail: Following the Intermountain Health deployment (first U.S. system to go live with Claire, August 13), further hospital placements from the company's sales funnel are the key near-term watch item for revenue ramp.

catalysts.label: CMS Medicare reimbursement decision
catalysts.detail: Analysts (Paradigm Capital) flag a possible Medicare reimbursement decision for Claire procedures near year-end 2026, which would formalize hospital economics under the Outpatient Prospective Payment System.

catalysts.label: Breast Cancer Awareness Month seasonal ramp
catalysts.detail: Q4 has historically been Perimeter's strongest quarter, driven by Breast Cancer Awareness Month screening/surgery volumes and patients clearing insurance deductibles, now amplified by Claire's commercial availability.

catalysts.label: Potential U.S. redomiciliation / Nasdaq uplisting
catalysts.detail: Company has been evaluating a redomiciling transaction from British Columbia to a U.S. jurisdiction to remove barriers to a future Nasdaq uplisting, seen as a potential re-rating catalyst for the TSXV/OTCQX-listed microcap.

pulse: Perimeter is now in early commercial execution on Claire, its FDA-approved AI-enabled OCT device for breast cancer margin assessment, highlighted by Intermountain Health's August 13 milestone as the first U.S. health system to fully deploy Claire commercially. Fresh sell-side attention (Paradigm Capital Top Pick at C$0.95, Brookline Buy initiation at C$1.54) reflects growing confidence in the hospital sales funnel, while non-dilutive Canadian government funding (INOVAIT) and a closed private placement shore up the balance sheet for the U.S. launch. Watch for Q2 2026 results (expected late August/early September), additional Claire hospital wins, and a potential CMS Medicare reimbursement decision by year-end as the next inflection points heading into the seasonally strong Q4 Breast Cancer Awareness Month period.
